articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
articles.snippet: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.

articles.title: Crypto investment firm RockawayX is betting $150 million on yield becoming next big use case
articles.snippet: The $2 billion digital-asset investment firm rolls out an initiative to back, build and provide liquidity to projects bringing real-world yields into DeFi.

articles.title: Brooklyn man sent to prison for 12 years for stealing $16M in a Coinbase phishing scheme
articles.snippet: The fraudster managed to scam about 100 people across the United States, convincing them of transferring funds to him, claiming their accounts had been hacked.

articles.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
articles.snippet: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

articles.title: DoubleZero brings dedicated fiber market data to Hyperliquid traders
articles.snippet: DoubleZero launched a dedicated fiber market data feed for Hyperliquid, giving professional trading firms faster access to its full order book.
